identity.platform: The merged code under app/core is the platform.

method.read: A build starts at the task file; its start element sends the model here. Then, in this order, whole: the code merged under app/core (the platform); this root; rules.xml; your task file; the design files your task file names, by the keys it lists. Nothing else: no earlier spec. The order is required: a session that reads a file out of this order reads again from the first file in order before it writes anything.
method.ownership: Create, modify and touch only the paths the task file lists under owns.
